title: Manufacturing unit operations
completionMessage: {mu.name} stock, its dispatch plan and the connected dealer {dealerConnect.dealer.name} are shown. The unit asset register (N21) is not defined yet.

oem-mu-view.proposedAction: Open the MU View and read the unit details
oem-mu-view.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the MU View layout cannot be shown. The details shown are the O33 fields for {mu.name}. What the edit, production, load plan and containers buttons lead to is not defined.

oem-mu-stock.proposedAction: Read the MU stock and the in-transit material
oem-mu-stock.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the fields for Reduce Stock cannot be shown. The spec does not capture them.

oem-dispatch-plan.proposedAction: Read the dispatch plan calendar for {dispatchPlan.month}
oem-dispatch-plan.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the meaning of the dispatch, build and component-short markers and the date range cannot be shown.

oem-click-connect-dealer.proposedAction: Check the connect a dealer search

oem-n21.proposedAction: Read the unit asset register requirement
oem-n21.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the Unit Asset Register (N21) cannot be shown. N21 defines and tracks fixed and movable assets per manufacturing unit.
oem-n21.performedText: read the unit asset register requirement for {mu.name}
